description: This Swift source file defines an enumeration 'OpenClawCanvasA2UIJSONL' with nested structures and static methods to parse, validate, decode, and encode JSON Lines messages related to a UI protocol (version 0.8). It handles message parsing from text, validation against specific allowed message types, and conversion to JSON array strings.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIJSONL
classes.description: Enumeration providing static methods for parsing, validating, decoding, and encoding UI message data in JSON Lines format for version 0.8 of the protocol.

classes.name: ParsedItem
classes.description: A structure representing a parsed line with its line number and message content, used internally for processing JSONL lines.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string containing JSON Lines into an array of ParsedItem, decoding each line as an AnyCodable object.

methods.name: validateV0_8
methods.description: Validates that each ParsedItem's message conforms to the expected set of message types for protocol version 0.8, throwing errors on violations.

methods.name: decodeMessagesFromJSONL
methods.description: Combines parsing and validation steps to convert JSON Lines text into an array of AnyCodable messages.

methods.name: encodeMessagesJSONArray
methods.description: Encodes an array of AnyCodable messages into a JSON array string.
